title: Speed and Comfort
question: Which type of transport does the writer prefer, do you think?

meanings.usage: 形容空间狭小而拥挤，通常指房间、车厢等地方
形容空气不流通、令人感到闷热的环境
形容缺乏变化、令人感到无聊的事物
指通过有节奏的声音或动作使人放松、想要入睡
特指火车上的卧铺座位或卧铺车厢
指在黑暗中或不方便的情况下笨拙地寻找东西
修饰动词，表示某事必然会发生
英国英语，指专供机动车辆高速行驶的公路
指运送人、车等穿过河流、海峡等水域的船
指通过威胁或气势使人感到害怕或胆怯

meanings.meaning: 令人兴奋的；使人高兴的
meanings.usage: 形容令人感到非常兴奋和愉悦的体验
指鸟或飞机在高空中飞翔，也可用于抽象意义
形容景色或事物极其壮观、美得令人屏息

meanings.meaning: 逃避现实者；追求逃避的人
meanings.usage: 指喜欢逃避现实、追求消遣娱乐的人
指人到达目的地后依然精神焕发、精力充沛

phrases.usage: 转移注意力；使不再想某事

examples.en: Reading is only a partial solution, for the monotonous rhythm of the wheels clicking on the rails soon lull you to sleep.
examples.zh: 阅读只是部分解决办法，因为车轮撞击铁轨的单调节奏很快就会让你昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: He tried to take his mind off the problem by watching TV.
examples.zh: 他试图通过看电视来转移注意力，不再想那个问题。

phrases.usage: 断断续续地；时有时无地

examples.en: During the day, sleep comes in snatches.
examples.zh: 白天的时候，睡眠断断续续。

examples.en: We only got the information in snatches.
examples.zh: 我们只是断断续续地得到这些信息。

examples.en: By comparison, ferry trips or cruises offer a great variety of civilized comforts.
examples.zh: 相比之下，渡船旅行或游轮提供了多种多样的文明享受。

examples.en: By comparison, city life is more exciting.
examples.zh: 相比之下，城市生活更加精彩。

examples.en: You can stretch your legs on the spacious decks, play games, meet interesting people and enjoy good food.
examples.zh: 你可以在宽敞的甲板上伸展双腿、做游戏、结识有趣的人、享用美食。

examples.en: We've been driving for hours. Let's stop and stretch our legs.
examples.zh: 我们已经开了几个小时的车了，停下来活动一下吧。

examples.en: Aeroplanes have the reputation of being dangerous and even hardened travellers are intimidated by them.
examples.zh: 飞机有危险的名声，甚至老练的旅行者也对其感到畏惧。

examples.en: She has the reputation of being very reliable.
examples.zh: 她有非常可靠的名声。

examples.en: For a few hours, you settle back in a deep armchair to enjoy the flight.
examples.zh: 在几个小时内，你可以靠在扶手椅上享受飞行。

examples.en: Settle back and enjoy the show.
examples.zh: 坐好享受演出吧。

examples.en: The journey is so smooth that there is nothing to prevent you from reading or sleeping.
examples.zh: 旅途如此平稳，没有什么能阻止你阅读或睡觉。

examples.en: Nothing can prevent me from achieving my goals.
examples.zh: 没有什么能阻止我实现目标。

examples.en: but more often than not, the greater part of the journey is spent on roads with few service stations and too much traffic.
examples.zh: 但更多的时候，大部分旅程是在只有很少服务站和交通拥挤的道路上度过的。

examples.en: More often than not, she arrives late for meetings.
examples.zh: 她开会经常迟到。

examples.en: enjoy good food--always assuming, of course, that the sea is calm.
examples.zh: 享用美食——当然，前提是海面平静。

examples.en: I'll help you, always assuming that you need my assistance.
examples.zh: 我会帮你的，只要你需要我的帮助。

examples.en: An aeroplane gets you to your destination rapidly.
examples.zh: 飞机会快速把你送到目的地。

examples.en: The bus will get you to the station on time.
examples.zh: 公共汽车会把你准时送到车站。

sentences.en: People travelling long distances frequently have to decide whether they would prefer to go by land, sea, or air.
sentences.zh: 长途旅行的人经常不得不决定他们是愿意乘陆路、海路还是空路。

sentences.en: Hardly anyone can positively enjoy sitting in a train for more than a few hours.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有人会真正喜欢坐几个小时以上的火车。

sentences.en: Train compartments soon get cramped and stuffy.
sentences.zh: 火车车厢很快就会变得又挤又闷。

sentences.en: It is almost impossible to take your mind off the journey.
sentences.zh: 几乎不可能不去想旅途。

sentences.en: Reading is only a partial solution, for the monotonous rhythm of the wheels clicking on the rails soon lull you to sleep.
sentences.zh: 阅读只是一个部分解决方案，因为车轮在铁轨上单调的咔嗒声很快就会让你昏昏欲睡。

sentences.en: During the day, sleep comes in snatches.
sentences.zh: 白天，睡眠是断断续续的。

sentences.en: At night, when you really wish to go to sleep, you rarely manage to do so.
sentences.zh: 晚上，当你真正想睡觉时，你却很少能做到。

sentences.en: If you are lucky enough to get a sleeper,
sentences.zh: 如果你足够幸运能得到一个卧铺，

sentences.en: you spend half the night staring at the small blue light in the ceiling, or fumbling to find your ticket for inspection.
sentences.zh: 你会花半夜的时间盯着天花板上那盏小蓝灯，或者摸索着找票以备查验。

sentences.en: Inevitably you arrive at your destination almost exhausted.
sentences.zh: 不可避免地，你到达目的地时几乎精疲力尽。

sentences.en: Long car journeys are even less pleasant, for it is quite impossible even to read.
sentences.zh: 长途汽车旅行甚至更不愉快，因为连阅读都是完全不可能的。

sentences.en: On motorways you can, at least, travel fairly safely at high speeds,
sentences.zh: 在高速公路上，你至少可以相当安全地高速行驶，

sentences.en: but more often than not, the greater part of the journey is spent on roads with few service stations and too much traffic.
sentences.zh: 但通常情况下，旅途的大部分时间是在服务站很少且交通拥堵的道路上度过的。

sentences.en: By comparison, ferry trips or cruises offer a great variety of civilized comforts.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，渡轮旅行或邮轮旅行提供了各种文明的舒适享受。

sentences.en: You can stretch your legs on the spacious decks, play games,
sentences.zh: 你可以在宽敞的甲板上伸展双腿，玩游戏，

sentences.en: meet interesting people and enjoy good food--always assuming, of course, that the sea is calm.
sentences.zh: 结识有趣的人，享受美食——当然，前提是海面风平浪静。

sentences.en: If it is not, and you are likely to get seasick, no form of transport could be worse.
sentences.zh: 如果不是，而且你很可能会晕船，那么没有哪种交通方式会更糟了。

sentences.en: Even if you travel in ideal weather, sea journeys take a long time.
sentences.zh: 即使你在理想的天气中旅行，海路旅行也需要很长时间。

sentences.en: Relatively few people are prepared to sacrifice holiday time for the pleasure of travelling by sea.
sentences.zh: 相对而言，很少有人愿意为了海上旅行的乐趣而牺牲假期时间。

sentences.en: Aeroplanes have the reputation of being dangerous and even hardened travellers are intimidated by them.
sentences.zh: 飞机有危险的名声，即使是经验丰富的旅行者也会被它们吓倒。

sentences.en: They also have the disadvantage of being an expensive form of transport.
sentences.zh: 它们还有另一个缺点，就是价格昂贵的交通方式。

sentences.en: But nothing can match them for speed and comfort.
sentences.zh: 但论速度和舒适度，没有任何交通工具能与它们相比。

sentences.en: Travelling at a height of 30,000 feet, far above the clouds, and at over 500 miles an hour is an exhilarating experience.
sentences.zh: 在三万英尺高空，远在云层之上，以每小时超过500英里的速度飞行，是一种令人兴奋的体验。

sentences.en: You do not have to devise ways of taking your mind off the journey, for an aeroplane gets you to your destination rapidly.
sentences.zh: 你不必绞尽脑汁去分散旅途的注意力，因为飞机能迅速将你送达目的地。

sentences.en: For a few hours, you settle back in a deep armchair to enjoy the flight.
sentences.zh: 几个小时里，你可以靠在舒适的扶手椅上享受飞行。

sentences.en: The real escapist can watch a film and sip champagne on some services.
sentences.zh: 真正的逃避现实者可以在某些航班上观看电影并品尝香槟。

sentences.en: But even when such refinements are not available, there is plenty to keep you occupied.
sentences.zh: 但即使没有这些精致的服务，也有很多事情能让你保持忙碌。

sentences.en: An aeroplane offers you an unusual and breathtaking view of the world.
sentences.zh: 飞机为你提供了独特而令人惊叹的世界景观。

sentences.en: You soar effortlessly over high mountains and deep valleys.
sentences.zh: 你毫不费力地翱翔于高山深谷之上。

sentences.en: You really see the shape of the land.
sentences.zh: 你真切地看到了大地的轮廓。

sentences.en: If the landscape is hidden from view,
sentences.zh: 如果风景被遮挡，

sentences.en: you can enjoy the extraordinary sight of unbroken cloud plains that stretch out for miles before you, while the sun shines brilliantly in a clear sky.
sentences.zh: 你可以欣赏到绵延数英里的连绵不断的云海奇景，同时阳光在晴朗的天空中灿烂地照耀。

sentences.en: The journey is so smooth that there is nothing to prevent you from reading or sleeping.
sentences.zh: 旅途如此平稳，没有什么能阻止你阅读或睡觉。

sentences.en: However you decide to spend your time, one thing is certain: you will arrive at your destination fresh and uncrumpled.
sentences.zh: 无论你决定如何度过时间，有一件事是肯定的：你将精神焕发、衣着整洁地抵达目的地。

sentences.en: You will not have to spend the next few days recovering from a long and arduous journey.
sentences.zh: 你不必花接下来的几天来从漫长而艰辛的旅程中恢复。

grammar.title: 否定副词开头的倒装句 (Inversion with Negative Adverbs)
grammar.definition: 当否定副词或否定意义的词组位于句首时，句子需要使用部分倒装语序，即把助动词或be动词提到主语前面。
grammar.structure: 否定词 + 助动词/be动词 + 主语 + 动词原形...
grammar.usage: 用于强调否定意义，常见的否定词包括：hardly, never, rarely, seldom, not until, no sooner, little等。

examples.en: Hardly anyone can positively enjoy sitting in a train for more than a few hours.
examples.zh: 几乎没有人能够真正享受连续坐几个小时的火车。

examples.en: Rarely do we see such a beautiful sunset.
examples.zh: 我们很少见到如此美丽的日落。

examples.en: Never have I seen such a magnificent building.
examples.zh: 我从未见过如此雄伟的建筑。

grammar.title: 形式主语it (Formal Subject It)
grammar.definition: 用it作形式主语，而把真正的主语（通常是不定式、动名词或从句）放在句子后面，使句子更加平衡。
grammar.structure: It + be + 形容词 + (for/of sb.) + to do sth.
grammar.usage: 当主语较长时，为了避免句子头重脚轻，使用形式主语it。

examples.en: It is almost impossible to take your mind off the journey.
examples.zh: 几乎不可能使自己不想到旅途。

examples.en: It is difficult to learn a new language.
examples.zh: 学习一门新语言是很难的。

examples.en: It is necessary for us to practice every day.
examples.zh: 我们每天练习是必要的。

grammar.title: 条件状语从句 (Conditional Clauses)
grammar.definition: 用于表达假设或条件的主从复合句，包括真实条件和虚拟条件。
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + 动词..., 主语 + 动词/情态动词...
grammar.usage: if引导的条件句可以表示真实条件或非真实（假设）的条件。

examples.en: If you are lucky enough to get a sleeper, you spend half the night staring at the small blue light.
examples.zh: 如果你足够幸运得到了卧铺，你会花半天时间盯着天花板上蓝色的小灯。

examples.en: If it is not, and you are likely to get seasick, no form of transport could be worse.
examples.zh: 如果海不平静，你可能会晕船，那么没有任何交通工具会比这更糟糕了。

patterns.pattern: Hardly anyone can + 动词原形...

original.en: Hardly anyone can positively enjoy sitting in a train for more than a few hours.
original.zh: 几乎没有人能够真正享受连续坐几个小时的火车。

examples.en: Hardly anyone can resist the temptation of free food.
examples.zh: 几乎没有人能抵制免费食物的诱惑。

examples.en: Hardly anyone can understand his complicated theory.
examples.zh: 几乎没有人能理解他那套复杂的理论。

patterns.pattern: It is + 形容词 + to do sth.

original.en: It is almost impossible to take your mind off the journey.
original.zh: 几乎不可能使自己不想到旅途。

examples.en: It is difficult to make a decision without all the facts.
examples.zh: 没有全部事实很难做决定。

examples.en: It is necessary to arrive early for the interview.
examples.zh: 提前到达面试是必要的。

original.en: By comparison, ferry trips or cruises offer a great variety of civilized comforts.
original.zh: 相比之下，渡船旅行或游轮提供了多种多样的文明享受。

examples.en: By comparison, living in the countryside is much quieter.
examples.zh: 相比之下，住在乡下要安静得多。

examples.en: By comparison, this restaurant offers better value for money.
examples.zh: 相比之下，这家餐厅的性价比更高。

original.en: But nothing can match them for speed and comfort.
original.zh: 但就速度和舒适度而言，没有任何交通工具能比得上它们。

examples.en: Nothing can replace the warmth of a mother's love.
examples.zh: 没有什么能取代母爱的温暖。

examples.en: Nothing can prevent him from reaching his goals.
examples.zh: 没有什么能阻止他实现目标。
